description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

As the first senior AI hire at an AI-powered marketing technology startup, you will own the quality and intelligence of multi-channel marketing agents. You will shape the agent architecture, evaluation systems, and learning loops, and help build the AI team as the company grows.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Improve agent output and content quality across social channels and article writing, making quality measurable through evaluation systems.

 - Improve search engine optimization and generative engine optimization performance.

 - Build feedback loops that help agents learn from real-world outcomes and performance signals.

 - Own and improve AI infrastructure, agent architecture, model strategy, and supporting data pipelines.

 - Help hire and lead the AI team as the organization grows.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 3 years of experience building production machine learning or AI systems, including recent hands-on experience shipping LLM products or agents.

 - Experience designing evaluation systems and learning from outcome signals at scale, particularly in search, ranking, or recommendations.

 - Strong TypeScript, including Next.js, and Python skills for building end-to-end products, data analysis, evaluation, and model work.

 - Strong judgment about output quality, with the ability to make it measurable and actionable.

 - Experience taking ownership in a startup or small-team environment; experience with search, algorithms, reinforcement learning, or marketing technology is relevant.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Target annual compensation is $180,000 to $230,000 USD. Visa sponsorship is available.


LOCATION

On-site in San Francisco, California.
